title: 3 AI updates: Gemini 4 Carbon, Fable 5.2, Decisions API #shorts
description:
AI news roundup in 40 seconds.

1. Google ne Gemini 4 Carbon launch kiya, apna sabse strong model. Introductory price $2 per million input tokens aur $10 per million output tokens; 30 November 2026 ke baad $4 aur $20.
2. Claude Fable 5.2 ab Claude Code me default Fable model hai: 1M context, $8 / $40 per million tokens.
3. Gemini Decisions API: ek request me 1,000 tak yes/no, choice ya rubric sawal, 150-250 ms end-to-end, $0.10 per 1M input tokens.

Sources (official pages):
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-carbon-now-available/
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/gemini-decisions-api/

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Google or Anthropic.
